The scaling factor 1 / √d_k is a variance normalizing divider applied to the dot products before Softmax.\n\n💡 Subject-Related Example:\nFor key dimension d_k = 64, multiplying two 64-dimensional vectors produces dot products with variance 64 and standard deviation √64 = 8. Dividing by √64 = 8 scales the scores back to unit variance 1.0, keeping values in the active, steep gradient region of Softmax.\n\n🚀 Real-World AI Use Case:\nUsed in the self-attention layers of all Transformer models (BERT, GPT-4, LLaMA-3).
